workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've found the following possible 30-minute slots for the partners' meeting next week based on Priya Raman's and Marcus Hale's calendars. Can you please check these against Elena Soto's and David Okafor's calendars?

Mon Nov 16: 09:00, 09:30
Tue Nov 17: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed Nov 18: 15:00, 15:30
Thu Nov 19: 10:00
Fri Nov 20: 11:00, 11:30

Let me know which one works for them.
- Alison

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison. Thanks for sending those slots over. I've checked Elena's and David's calendars, and unfortunately none of those times work for them.

Here is a full list of all the 30-minute slots where both Elena and David are available next week. Can you please check these against Priya's and Marcus's calendars?

Mon Nov 16: 11:00, 11:30
Tue Nov 17: 09:00, 09:30
Wed Nov 18: 13:00, 13:30
Thu Nov 19: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
Fri Nov 20: 14:30, 15:00, 15:30

Let me know which one works for them.
- Brad

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked the list of times you sent. It looks like Thursday at 14:30 is the only time that works for Priya and Marcus as well. I'm going ahead and booking that time now. Please send the confirmation email once I've created the booking.
- Alison

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, just checking in. Have you been able to book the meeting for Thursday at 14:30? I'm ready to send the confirmation email as soon as you give me the green light. - Brad

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad, yes, I created the booking for Thursday at 14:30 about 30 minutes ago. Please go ahead and send the confirmation email. Thanks. - Alison

emails.body: This email confirms the 30-minute partners' meeting for next week. The meeting is scheduled for Thursday, November 19, at 14:30 Eastern.
